purpose: Member-commune outlines for the four wilayas whose boundary the 2026-reform membership correction touches (private tracker #171): Ouargla 30, Ghardaia 47, Touggourt 55, El Meniaa 58. scripts/fix-wilaya-membership.mjs reads the three outlines it transfers from here, and test/wilaya-membership.test.mjs reads all of them to check each rebuilt polygon against the union of its own members.
source: OpenStreetMap admin_level=8 commune relations with full geometry (`out geom`), via Overpass

reduction.from: research/_commune-centres/commune-boundaries.json of the 2026-09-29 commune-centre audit (private tracker #170), reduced from the 52 MB `out geom` pull: outer and inner rings stitched from the relation ways, Douglas-Peucker at tolerance_deg, rounded to `precision` decimals

note: Copied verbatim from that audit rather than re-pulled: Overpass mirrors are independently replicated and drift by hours, so a second pull would not be the same data the audit measured. `outline: null` marks a commune with no admin_level=8 relation in that pull.
